radar.selection_rule: Highest selection_score among players with enough appearances, unless a specific player name is requested.

storylines: Jönköpings Södra records 3320 defensive actions in the sampled window.
The average defensive action starts at pitch height 40.2, with 26% of actions occurring high up the pitch.
Most defensive volume comes from duels actions (1512 events).
Opponents produced 166 shots worth 17.16 xG against Jönköpings Södra in this sample.
For context, Jönköpings Södra produced 197 own shots worth 23.12 xG in the same match sample.
The shot-against sample includes 17 goals conceded.

The radar player is chosen as A. Eriksson because that player has the highest selection score among teammates with at least 5 appearances in the comparison set of 18 players. It changes automatically when another player's season performance overtakes that score or when a specific player is requested.
